verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skills package that runs inside a host agent such as Claude. The assistant you delegate to is the host platform's agent, not one built into this product, and host-platform capabilities earn no credit. The evidence shows the skill guiding the host agent through a logo workflow, but there is no first-party built-in AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
